verdict.rationale: Customer.io explicitly claims UI parity: "Your AI can do anything you'd do by clicking or typing in Customer.io." Its CLI exposes the Journeys UI API and the Pipelines API with full workspace access and self-describing endpoints, and a public OpenAPI spec was confirmed by probe. The MCP server hedges this to "just about anything," and the App API docs describe setting up broadcasts in the UI before triggering them by API, so complete parity is not fully demonstrated. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of full UI/API parity, explicit documentation that UI-only setup steps such as broadcast creation can be done via API, and an endpoint-level parity matrix.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Your AI can do anything you'd do by clicking or typing in Customer.io.
The Customer.io CLI is a command-line tool that gives AI agents and scripts full access to your Customer.io workspaces.
It covers the Journeys UI API and CDP Data Pipelines API through a single `cio api` command—no per-endpoint code, no SDK boilerplate.
Primary OpenAPI spec for the Track (ingress), App, and Design Studio APIs together, at the conventional path
